about_the_game:
World Background

You are an exceptional burger flipper. On a quiet evening, just as you were about to close up shop and head home, a surge of powerful magic teleported you to a world teeming with demons. Unfortunately, you have been chosen by the succubus Lilith. She demands that you continue your work, opening your shop in this world to craft burgers and satisfy these ravenous demonic customers.

Gameplay & Mechanics

In this game, players will experience using various monster-shaped fast-food machinery. Their bizarre operation methods will offer you a novel burger-crafting experience. As you master each stage and earn enough gold coins, you can freely upgrade your shop – unlocking or adding new equipment to expand your operation.

Demonic Customers & Demon Lady Lords

Through your diligent management, your shop will grow increasingly popular. This will attract a wider variety of customers with unique forms. However, if you neglect their needs, they might use their abilities to cause you significant trouble. Fail to satisfy them, and you'll be harmed by the hungry demons... until you're devoured.

Among these patrons, beyond the basic demons, expect sudden visits from uniquely formed Demon Lady Lords!

Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-9300 or AMD Ryzen 3 2300X
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 950 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 1 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon R9 380

short_description: This is a cooking simulation game that challenges your time management and precision skills. Set in a demon-filled world, you must continuously make burgers to satisfy the demonic appetites during business hours. Only by doing so can you stay alive! Go for it! Good luck!
